scope: Bounded collection research: signed decoder groups, probability-bound census, actual owner audit and conditional-attention algebra. No production candidate or training repair.

aggregation.order: Separate task, cohort, original DT-ratio/native-ratio crossed cell, exposure, initial state and original optimizer minibatch. For bounded frequencies/author quality metrics use trajectory means then equal initial-state means.
aggregation.moments: The first four c intervals bound A/r, each separately. The final c>100 interval is unbounded; finite data do not identify population moments. Do not pool their raw means, fit an asserted tail law or claim finite/infinite expectation.
aggregation.primary: Original author cumulative deletion curves, signed RISE and positive MAS; retain per-trajectory and per-state outputs. Layer/gradient/single-delete analyses supplement these.
aggregation.missing: AppWorld two development captures remain missing; no zero imputation, no new sampling or held-out quality tuning.
aggregation.limitation: The frozen inputs come from existing prepared reward-bearing episodes, not an unconditional survey of every training action or the historical collapsed policy. Frequencies are conditional on this collection.

conclusions: The single-token GDN localization is not sufficient to select a GDN-only repair. Across-state signed group residuals include opposing full-attention-decoder and final-norm/head terms in both tasks.
Groups are whole decoders including residual/MLP/norm/mixer/gate. A telescoping path decomposition is not an intervention on FA, FLA, GDN or the head, and its largest term is not a causal ranking.

TextCraft saved probability-bound observations span 14 states, mainly 1<c<=2. AppWorld has none in the available captured development positions, so this constraint cannot be asserted as a shared degradation explanation.

The existing six TextCraft 2<c<=10 bound observations all have original actor positions and native rebatches. Five fresh DT implied logp remain positive; one near-boundary observation no longer violates the bound. Preserve batching drift and do not label every raw crossing an official numerical-tolerance failure.

The measured current finite-attention callback and gate use global paired backgrounds. Conditional row-replacement algebra provides a specific internal direction to investigate; it is not yet a demonstrated whole-model improvement.

algebra_status.native_FA_source_contract: Pinned public FA source confirms bottom-right alignment and LSE access without requesting the quadratic probability output when dropout_p=0. This is not a runtime packed/suffix or allocation test.
algebra_status.completeness: Conditional KV, query, own-row interaction and gate requirements are derived together. No KV-only patch or unconditional head residual correction is accepted.
algebra_status.unresolved: Complete tile/live-memory work, whole-model combination behavior and a candidate measurement on the same frozen collection remain unimplemented.

cost_geometry.possible_native_work: Two strict-past native FA forward calls per full-attention layer, plus conditional finite tiles in the owner. This is operator work, not two extra whole-model passes or per-token DT calls.
cost_geometry.required_cost_accounting: Derive and count the complete conditional query and KV tile implementation and live tensors before any GPU candidate. Do not promise that two FA forwards are free or convert FLOPs into wall-clock speed.
cost_geometry.forbidden: No full attention matrix, source-by-time hidden-state bank, additional per-source model forward, sign correction or extreme-source replacement.

algebra_status.no_conservation_substitute: Local leave-one-row effects do not generally sum to a joint endpoint difference. Do not rescale them to enforce closure or call algebra a quality/tolerance test.

official_tolerance_status: No new FA/FLA/VERL/vLLM official tolerance result is claimed. Existing operator receipts are unchanged; these analyses define no new acceptance tolerance.

historical_version_mapping_as_recorded.meaning: Deployment directory IDs, upstream commits, DT numerical reference, actor patch commit and documentation commit are distinct identifiers; none substitutes for another

runtime_binding.mapping_scope: Version mapping is inherited record context, not new deployment verification. Actual inspected file paths/SHA and finite library SHA are in the linked owner receipt.
runtime_binding.formal_AppWorld: Stopped; no formal restart or checkpoint restoration performed here.

bounded_research_decisions: No automatic dev expansion or held-out scoring. Reuse current native/actor/layer receipts first.
Do not select a component from residual magnitude alone or pool tail and bulk into one improvement score.
Do not start an additional GPU candidate before deriving its complete owner operation and cost; this is a bounded implementation question, not permission to redesign PPO or Q/V/A.

Any future candidate must be compared with original author cumulative deletion/RISE/MAS on the same frozen development trajectories and separately checked on tail strata and gradient impact. Single-delete points cannot replace those metrics.
No per-source rescue forwards, top-k extreme replacement, clipping, multipliers or learned critic added.
